claim: A cluster mode disabled cluster with no replicas loses all its data when the node fails. A cluster mode enabled cluster with no replicas and a failed node loses all the data in that shard.
question: What data is lost if a node fails and there are no replicas, in each cluster mode?

values.display: you experience loss of all data in that shard

qualifiers.scope: Valkey or Redis OSS clusters without replicas
qualifiers.condition: no replicas and the node fails
